objects.name: Analytic 2130
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux service process making write Application Programming Interface (API) calls to field device Input/Output (I/O) at a rate exceeding the configured scan rate, from a User Identifier (UID) associated with the Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA)/control application but exhibiting anomalous write volume. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: auditd:SYSCALL
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): write Application Programming Interface (API) invocation rate to single Input/Output (I/O) point from Industrial Control Systems (ICS) service User Identifier (UID) exceeds max write rate per point

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Time window over which write rate is measured for threshold comparison.
Maximum rate at which the physical process value is expected to legitimately change state.
Maximum legitimate write queue depth for SCADA/DCS write operations to a single point.
Maximum legitimate write rate to a single I/O point, derived from the device's configured scan cycle and physical process response time.
